expected_rate: One durable decision row after each completed session when F6 is enabled; no runtime rows while F6 remains disabled.
reversal: Any F6 starter is evaluated before 4:16 PM ET, lacks both completed-session SPY crash damage and heightened VIX confirmation, accepts stale/misaligned/nonfinite or internally inconsistent evidence, or sends an order when exact evidence cannot be appended.

metrics.name: Empirical F6 starter evidence integrity
metrics.bound: Every decision is evaluated no earlier than 4:16 PM ET, is current-session, uses completed aligned SPY/VIX/VIX3M bars, carries crash tier A/B/C plus the exact input SHA256, and an executed event embeds the same semantically revalidated evidence object.
